question: Which of these is the title of the first novel of Anand Neelakantan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asura : Tale of the Vanquished.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Asura: Tale of the Vanquished" **is the title of the first novel of** Anand Neelakantan**.
 
• Anand Neelakantan is an Indian author who has written books in the mythological fiction and historical fiction genres.
 
• "Satya Ke Prayog" is a book written by Mahatma Gandhi, which is a collection of his writings and speeches on various topics.
 
• "The Immortals of Meluha" is a book written by Amish Tripathi, which is the first book in the Shiva Trilogy series. It is a work of mythological fiction.
 
• "Kadambari" is a Sanskrit novel written by Banabhatta, which is considered one of the earliest examples of Indian literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The editors of Amazon works included Asura in their list of "100 books by Indian authors to read in a lifetime".
 
• Leadstart Publishing released Asura: Tale of the Vanquished on May 14, 2012.
 
• This work of mythological fiction tells the story of the Ramayana from the viewpoints of Ravana and Bhadra, a common Asura.
